_readme: Answer-quality evaluation set. Each entry runs through the REAL pipeline (planner, retrieval, writer) as the given role.
Checks: must (every entry appears in the answer, case-insensitive; 'a|b' means either), must_not, confidence (expected level),
list (a numbered list must appear), table/template/flow/triage _expected (that event must be emitted), paths_expected (an engineer
answer names a file), and the global banned phrases. history = earlier turns for a follow-up question.
verified=false means the expectation was written from the graph/mirror by the developer and still needs a human to confirm it is the
right answer, not just the current one. source = ask_log (a real question) or constructed (coverage).
